title: The School of Ageless Wisdom
subtitle: The lessons: Sections A to D, the Tarot Instruction, and Hermetic Science and Practice
author: Paul Foster Case
imprint: Set from the School's typed lessons. Rosicrucian Developers, 2026
edition: The typed lessons, as the School issued them to its students; the typescript is undated
publicDomain: Paul Foster Case died in 1954. The School's lessons were issued privately to its students and never published; under US law an unpublished work's copyright runs seventy years from its author's death, so they entered the public domain on 1 January 2025.
note: Set from the School's typed lessons, contributed by Tony DeLuce, as transcribed and corrected for agelesswisdom.school from 2025 (that site's repository, rosicrucian-dev/agelesswisdom, holds the work of reading them in), and brought here in October 2026 with the words unchanged (editorial/port.py). The School's separately issued pieces, Correlation of Sound and Colour and the Oracle of Tarot, are not in this book.
